results: New players get $500 once and see it in wallet and compact sidebar
Ordinary players can transfer money and recipients receive confirmation
Invalid and unaffordable transfers cannot change balances
Admin add/remove works from console; ordinary players cannot grant themselves money
Everyone can view the top-money leaderboard
Listing escrows the held stack and persists its fixed total price
Viewing and cancelling a purchase confirmation does not spend money
Confirmed purchase pays seller exactly once and puts the exact item in buyer mailbox
Full inventory cannot consume or partially deliver a mailbox stack
Mailbox delivers the exact purchased stack without leaving a duplicate claim
Cancelled listings return the complete stack through mailbox
Offline sellers receive proceeds without losing their wallet or receiving starter money again
Transaction history includes sale receipts
Market category filters and navigation open as native inventory menus
Public lobby shows waiting heads and stakes; confirmation/back and shift-click cannot take items or charge money
One waiting wager per player and self-join protection; command cancellation refunds the stake
Cancel My Flip button refunds unmatched wagers
Joining saves one 50/50 winner and reserves both stakes; payout does not happen immediately
A stale confirmation cannot start a second match or charge a third player
Red/green animation ends with matching winner/loser frames, exact pot payout and one win receipt; closing/reopening cannot reroll
Completed match provides a Back to lobby button and enabled sounds reach both players
Expired public wagers refund held money automatically
Waiting host disconnect refunds the wager without another starter grant
Disconnecting during an animation preserves the winner and pays normally, including offline wallets
Reloaded sound-disabled setting mutes ticking and result sounds without changing payout
Admin can place a persistent in-world text leaderboard at spawn
Configurable chat reminders advertise auction and public coin flips
Paper upgrades v1.5 config with a backup, preserves custom expiry/mute, and adds lobby defaults
Shutdown during an animation completes the saved winner once and restart preserves both balances
Recovery reconciles real inventory snapshots before and after removal without replaying an item transfer
Wallets, offline mail and spawn leaderboard persist across full restart without duplicate $500 grants
Admin removal deletes the in-world board and saved location
